stories.title: Kabinet wil 250 zieke en gewonde Gazaanse kinderen naar Jordanië halen

en.title: Cabinet wants to bring 250 sick and wounded Gaza children to Jordan
en.summary: The Dutch government is allocating 6 million euros to evacuate 250 sick and severely wounded children from Gaza for treatment in Jordan through the World Health Organization, with additional funding to support aid organizations.

stories.title: Powerbanks die ontvlammen in een vliegtuig: waarom gebeurt het en hoe gevaarlijk is het?

en.title: Powerbanks that ignite on an airplane: why does it happen and how dangerous is it?
en.summary: The article examines the causes and risks of powerbank fires on aircraft.

stories.title: Kabinet wil 250 zieke Gazaanse kinderen laten evacueren naar Jordanië voor medische zorg

en.title: Cabinet wants 250 sick Gaza children evacuated to Jordan for medical care
en.summary: The government is facilitating the evacuation of 250 sick children from Gaza to Jordan for medical treatment.

stories.title: Nederland trekt geld uit voor zieke kinderen in Gaza, maar haalt ze niet hierheen

en.title: Netherlands allocates funds for sick children in Gaza, but will not bring them here
en.summary: The Dutch government is providing funding to enable 250 Gaza children to receive treatment in Jordan, while currently declining to bring patients to the Netherlands.

stories.title: Kabinet regelt evacuatie 250 zieke kinderen uit Gaza naar Jordanië, ondanks bestand ‘amper’ zorg beschikbaar in Gaza

en.title: Cabinet arranges evacuation of 250 sick children from Gaza to Jordan, despite ceasefire with 'barely' medical care available in Gaza
en.summary: The Dutch government is allocating 12 million euros for medical assistance to Palestinian children and organizing the evacuation of 250 sick children from Gaza to Jordan.

stories.title: Veertien aanhoudingen in Gelderse Opheusden na nieuw gewelddadig azc-protest

en.title: Fourteen arrests in Gelderland's Opheusden after new violent asylum center protest
en.summary: Fourteen people were arrested in Opheusden following a violent protest against a potential asylum seeker center.

stories.title: Jan G. uit Overasselt aangehouden in Duitsland voor cocaïnesmokkel

en.title: Jan G. from Overasselt arrested in Germany for cocaine smuggling
en.summary: A 28-year-old man from Overasselt is suspected of involvement in a cocaine shipment of nearly 3,900 kilograms from Ghana that was intercepted in France on September 7.

stories.title: Veertien arrestaties bij azc-protest Opheusden, flinke schade aan gemeentehuis

en.title: Fourteen arrests at asylum center protest in Opheusden, significant damage to municipal building
en.summary: Fourteen men were arrested Thursday evening during a protest against a possible asylum seeker center in Opheusden, with the municipal building sustaining substantial damage.

stories.title: Bondscoach Xavi selecteert Van Bommel, Zechiël en Veerman, Depay ontbreekt

en.title: Coach Xavi selects Van Bommel, Zechiël and Veerman, Depay absent
en.summary: National team coach Xavi has announced his squad selection, including Van Bommel, Zechiël and Veerman while excluding Depay.

stories.title: Bondscoach Xavi behoudt een deel van het fundament van Oranje én selecteert op enkele posities door: geen Depay en Weghorst

en.title: Coach Xavi retains part of Orange's foundation and makes selections in some positions: no Depay and Weghorst
en.summary: New national coach Xavi has retained some core players while making changes in other positions, notably excluding all-time top scorer Depay and Weghorst from the squad.

stories.title: Veertien arrestaties na azc-protest Opheusden, komen allemaal uit de buurt

en.title: Fourteen arrests after asylum center protest in Opheusden, all from the area
en.summary: Police made fourteen arrests during a protest in Opheusden against a planned asylum center. Most suspects were from the local municipality, with charges including failing to follow police orders and assault.

stories.title: Van Dijk, Veerman in Xavi's first Oranje squad; Depay, Weghorst out

en.title: Van Dijk, Veerman in Xavi's first Oranje squad; Depay, Weghorst out
en.summary: Coach Xavi Hernández has selected his first Dutch national team squad, retaining captain Van Dijk while excluding all-time leading scorer Depay and Weghorst.
